source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Climate requirements are covered (temperature and rainfall ranges suited to soybean), followed by soil requirements including the value of liming acid soils. Land preparation instructions describe ploughing and harrowing to a fine tilth, with the manual noting that a well-prepared seedbed is critical since soybean germination is sensitive to soil crusting and compaction.
